role: Game-mechanics review only; fixed policies, not optimum search or human enjoyment
matched: Branch each of the three actual offered choices from exactly the same checkpoint. Common exogenous weather and incident scenario; subsequent upgrades use the fixed preference. Front-8 checkpoints follow the default front-4 choice, not every earlier branch.
policies_defined: Both prioritize descending visible pressure. Crew-first assigns available crews before thresholded water; water-first uses thresholded water before assigning remaining crews. No action-policy search.
primary: Paired final reserve difference between jointly offered choices, within policy/milestone/checkpoint
attrition: Report seeds unable to reach each fixed-prefix milestone. Paired outcomes are conditional on reaching it and both choices being offered.
limits: Toy game counterfactuals under two fixed heuristics and 32 seeds distinct from balance/scouting studies. Not optimal policies, human skill/enjoyment, causal suppression effectiveness, hectares, predictive accuracy or quantum advantage. No rule tuning follows automatically; no final models or scientific labels are read.
pre_execution_amendment: Before first execution, create only the parent cache directories for fresh-checkout reproduction; the run output directory stays exclusive. Policies, seeds and rules unchanged.
